# 12th Kalasha International Film & TV Awards

The 12th Kalasha International Film & TV Awards ceremony, presented by the Kenya Film Commission, honoured the best in Kenyan television and film for the year 2022. It took place on 3 December 2022 at the Safari Park Hotel in Nairobi, Kenya. The awards recognize excellence in storytelling, direction, performance and technical execution in the Kenyan entertainment industry.
Notable winners of the night included Philip Karanja's Click Click Bang, which secured Best Feature Film and the Viewers' Choice Award, alongside Ayaanle which swept multiple technical and directing categories. Prominent Kenyan actors such as Basil Mungai, Nyokabi Macharia, Joe Kinyua and Sanaipei Tande were recognized for their leading performances.
Ceremony
The 12th edition of the awards ceremony was held on 3 December 2022 at the Safari Park Hotel in Nairobi. The gala celebrated outstanding achievements in the film and television sectors, recognizing productions that excelled over the eligibility period. The chief guest at the event was the cabinet secretary for youth affairs, sports and the arts, Ababu Namwamba, alongside KFC CEO Timothy Owase.
The ceremony saw a record number of film submissions—up to 217 compared to 149 in the previous year—reflecting the rapid growth of content creation in the region. Click Click Bang and Ayaanle dominated the film categories, with Click Click Bang winning five awards, including Best Feature Film. In the television categories, Kina won Best TV Drama, while This Love was named Best TV Show. Special honorary awards were also presented, including the Lifetime Achievement Award to veteran actor Raymond Ofula and the Kituo Halisi Award to NTV.
